verdict.rationale: Datalab's own docs say structured extraction returns fields "with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability." That is first-party provenance for extracted fields, which supports the core of the story. However, the evidence is a single overview-level line, and it does not show page numbers or source snippets per field. missing for 10: documented per-field page number, per-field source snippet text, a response-schema or API-reference showing the citation structure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify

citations.quote: Extract specific fields with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability
Extract specific fields from documents by providing a JSON schema. Marker parses the document and fills in your schema with extracted values.
